# util-linux compatibility — `org.ono.compat.util-linux`

Version `0.1.0`; process.exec executables: `lsblk`, `findmnt`, `lsns`. Everything below is the pack's contract; an invocation not listed under an adapter runs raw, and the limits state what the adapted form does not carry.

## lsblk — `org.ono.compat.util-linux.lsblk`

Block devices as `ono.block-device/1` records, from `lsblk --json --list --bytes`.

| | |
|---|---|
| executable | `lsblk` |
| versions | `>=2.37` |
| tier | A — structured native output |
| schema | `ono.block-device/1` |
| decoder | `json` |
| demand | structured, interactive |
| fallback | raw |
| fixtures | `util-linux/lsblk` |

### Supported invocations

| invocation | runs as | flags allowed | flags required |
|---|---|---|---|
| `lsblk [-a\|--all] [-d\|--nodeps] [device …]` | `lsblk --json --list --bytes --output NAME,PATH,TYPE,SIZE,FSTYPE,MOUNTPOINTS,MODEL,SERIAL,RO,RM,PKNAME,MAJ:MIN` | `-a`, `--all`, `-d`, `--nodeps` | — |

### Fields

| field | from |
|---|---|
| `device_number` | `maj:min` |
| `filesystem` | `fstype` |
| `model` | `model` |
| `mountpoints` | `mountpoints` |
| `name` | `name` |
| `parent` | `pkname` |
| `path` | `path` |
| `read_only` | `ro` |
| `removable` | `rm` |
| `serial` | `serial` |
| `size` | `size`, unit Bytes |
| `type` | `type` |

### Limits

- Flags that change what a row means — `-p/--paths`, `-e/--exclude`, `-x/--sort`, `-o/--output`, `-f`, `-m`, `-t` — are not adapted; the invocation runs raw.
- The tree lsblk draws is carried as `parent`, never as indentation.

## findmnt — `org.ono.compat.util-linux.findmnt`

Mounted filesystems as `ono.mount/1` records, from `findmnt --json --list --bytes`.

| | |
|---|---|
| executable | `findmnt` |
| versions | `>=2.37` |
| tier | A — structured native output |
| schema | `ono.mount/1` |
| decoder | `json` |
| demand | structured, interactive |
| fallback | raw |
| fixtures | `util-linux/findmnt` |

### Supported invocations

| invocation | runs as | flags allowed | flags required |
|---|---|---|---|
| `findmnt [--real] [target\|source]` | `findmnt --json --list --bytes --output TARGET,SOURCE,FSTYPE,OPTIONS` | `--real` | — |

### Fields

| field | from |
|---|---|
| `filesystem` | `fstype` |
| `options` | `options` |
| `read_only` | `options` |
| `source` | `source` |
| `target` | `target` |

### Limits

- `--fstab`, `--kernel`, `--mtab`, `--poll`, `--evaluate` and output selection are not adapted; the invocation runs raw.
- `device` is null: findmnt names the source, not the device object.

## lsns — `org.ono.compat.util-linux.lsns`

Namespaces as `ono.namespace/1` records, from `lsns --json`.

| | |
|---|---|
| executable | `lsns` |
| versions | `>=2.37` |
| tier | A — structured native output |
| schema | `ono.namespace/1` |
| decoder | `json` |
| demand | structured, interactive |
| fallback | raw |
| fixtures | `util-linux/lsns` |

### Supported invocations

| invocation | runs as | flags allowed | flags required |
|---|---|---|---|
| `lsns [-t\|--type type]` | `lsns --json --output NS,TYPE,NPROCS,PID,PPID,USER,UID,COMMAND` | `-t <value>`, `--type <value>` | — |

### Fields

| field | from |
|---|---|
| `command` | `command` |
| `id` | `ns` |
| `parent_pid` | `ppid` |
| `pid` | `pid` |
| `processes` | `nprocs` |
| `type` | `type` |
| `uid` | `uid` |
| `user` | `user` |

### Limits

- `lsns <namespace>` lists processes rather than namespaces and is not adapted.
